name: 中国移动云南公司普洱数据中心 (China Mobile Yunnan Pu'er Data Center)
notes: Completed and launched; makes 'data stays in Pu'er' possible for the city (per aggregator repost of operator announcement). Capacity not disclosed.

name: 京东智联云（玉溪）数字经济产业园 (JD Cloud Yuxi Digital Economy Industrial Park)
notes: JD(Yunnan) digital economy park in Yuxi, launched ~2020; primarily a cloud/digital-economy park rather than a large dedicated colo campus.

name: 玉溪绿电+智算项目 (Yuxi Green-Power + Smart-Computing program)
notes: Yuxi named alongside Baoshan in Yunnan's coordinated '绿电+智算' planning; no named facility yet.

name: 阿里巴巴千岛湖数据中心 (Alibaba Qiandao Lake Data Center, Chun'an County)
notes: Launched Sep 2015; Zhejiang's largest single DC at build, ~Tier 4 design, deep-lake water cooling (annual avg PUE <1.3); Hangzhou is part of the Yangtze River Delta 东数西算 hub.

name: 平湖润泽智算中心项目 (Runze Pinghu Smart Computing Center, Xindai Town)
notes: Total investment 46.8B RMB; 344 mu, >560k sqm, 4 high-grade smart-compute buildings planned; Pinghu gov accepted filing of D-zone 220kV substation (2026) - large-scale hyperscale project in progress.

name: 中国联通乌镇智算中心 (China Unicom Wuzhen Smart Computing Center, Tongxiang)
notes: Power-infrastructure build for Unicom's Wuzhen smart-computing center reported by equipment vendor; Wuzhen (Tongxiang, Jiaxing) hosts internet-industry events.

name: 中国移动长三角（宁波）数据中心 (China Mobile Yangtze River Delta Ningbo Data Center)
notes: Total compute 395.7 PFLOPS, 83PB storage, all-flash architecture; selected as a National New-Type Data Center typical case (Mar 2023).

name: 绍兴数字科创产业园智算中心 (Shaoxing Digital Innovation Park Smart Computing Center, Phase 2/3, Yuecheng)
developer: Shaoxing Yuecheng Jishan Computing Technology (越城区稽山算力科技)
notes: Design-bid notice (Dec 2024): 36,000 sqm smart-compute center, 25 mu, ~7,000 racks planned, 30,000 PFlops target - would rank among Zhejiang's largest; provincial gov source.

name: 绍兴市鉴水数智产业园及算力中心项目 (Shaoxing Jianshui Digital-Smart Industrial Park & Compute Center)
developer: Zhonglian Construction (中联建工) published renderings
notes: Project launch announced; total investment 12B RMB, ~180k sqm, located in Yuecheng District; early-stage.

name: 浙东南智算中心一期 (Southeast Zhejiang Smart Computing Center Phase 1, Huangyan)
notes: Phase 1 completed Dec 2023 (acceptance): 400P FP16 with domestic Cambricon AI chips at Yuanqiao/Fanrong industrial park; compute leasing exceeded 150% by Nov 2023.

name: 浙东南智算中心二期（浙东南天翼智算谷）(Southeast Zhejiang Smart Computing Center Phase 2)
notes: Zhejiang 2025 Q1 major-project groundbreaking (Mar 2025); 4,000P compute, total investment 5B RMB; construction >80% with completion targeted before 2026 Spring Festival (Huangyan District gov reports).

name: 温州智算中心一期 (Wenzhou Smart Computing Center Phase 1, Longwan)
notes: Procurement launched Nov 2023 (max bid 85.04M RMB): ~248 PFlops FP16 GPU-cluster smart-compute center at Wenzhou Cloud Computing Center, Longwan District Mingzhu Rd 788.

name: 中国联通温州龙湾核心机房 (China Unicom Wenzhou Longwan Core Data Center)
notes: Existing core facility undergoing HV/LV power-system expansion (2025 tender); indicates active operation and growth of the Longwan facility.
